dispatches.message: MAJOR ORDER WON In a showcase of their unyielding valor and mastery over thermal firepower, the Helldivers have successfully repelled the mutated Terminid offensive from their primary targets. However, infestation vectors continue to increase exponentially. The Ministry of Science has declared a Tyrannical Pandemic, the first in over a century.

STRATEGIC ADVISORY All Helldivers should factor the following advisory into their strategic decision-making: Enemy forces stage their attacks on our planets from an originating planet. Liberating the originating planet will end the enemy attack immediately. In the current operational context, liberating GRAND ERRANT would end the current TERMINID attacks upon ACRUX IX, GEMMA and POLARIS PRIME.
GLOOM SPREAD DETECTED The Gloom is spreading at an unprecedented pace. GRAND ERRANT is now surrounded by low-density Gloom, and other planets in the sector are expected to follow.

NEW MAJOR ORDER In an unprovoked, unforeseeable assault illustrative of their depravity, a newly mutated strain of Terminids have launched a wave of attacks across multiple TCS+ sectors, threatening to smother innocent colonies in a sea of fascist insect tyranny. The Helldivers must successfully defend against 7 Terminid attacks to halt this tyrannical onslaught and restore order.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers successfully eliminated the mandated quota of Terminids with their judicious use of the INCINERATOR FRV Stratagem, delivering a crushing blow to alien insolence, and silencing equally dangerous rumours of TCS+ malfunctions. Coupled with the assurance that any anomalous readings along the perimeter will be suitably scrutinized, domestic markets immediately responded with patriotic vigor, reaffirming the infallibility of Super Earth, economic or otherwise.

STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE COMPLETED The Helldivers successfully held CRIMSICA, FRONTERIA, DARIUS II and ACHERNAR SECUNDUS and in doing so, confirmed which of the reported TCS+ breaches were truly legitimate. To ensure all sections of TCS+ system safely report a return to maximal efficiency, High Command has directed additional SEAF mobilizations—the most capable pest control in the known galaxy—to wall off affected planets for the remainder of this campaign.

NEW STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE Incongruously, increases in TCS+ breaches continue to be reported. While these reports will almost certainly be attributed to departmental cost-cutting during routine rewiring of multiple TCS+ sections, Helldivers with surplus operational capacity are invited to verify their veracity, should they choose. Helldivers: investigate and, if warranted, hold FRONTERIA, CRIMSICA, DARIUS II and ACHERNAR SECUNDUS.

Xenoentomology Center Restructuring The Chief of Terminid Epidemiology has been stripped of their rank and detained for trial. A tribunal of trusted experts will ascertain whether the former Chief’s incompetence in failing to predict the Terminids’ recent unprovoked mutations and attacks constitutes criminality –or treason. Their replacement is expected to be named upon the trial’s conclusion.

GLOOM SPREAD DETECTED The Gloom is spreading at an unprecedented pace. GACRUX is now surrounded by low-density Gloom, and other planets in the sector are expected to follow. Worse, there are indications of new Hive Worlds forming, corrupting biomes formerly resistant to severe infestation. This may represent a novel strain of Gloom spores, adapted to more extreme conditions.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Seditious and entirely false rumours regarding TCS+ malfunctions are spreading across civilian channels, resulting in unfounded economic panic. SEAF Intelligence confirms: there is zero actionable peril to fully insured citizens. To restore public confidence, the Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 700,000,000 Terminids. To aid in swiftly safeguarding Federal prosperity, High Command has authorized and subsidized fleetwide availability of the INCINERATOR FRV Stratagem.

MISINFORMATION ALERT Helldivers are to be aware of recent falsified reports fraudulently claiming that Termicide 2.0 exposure has increased the spread of the Gloom. The Ministry of Truth is investigating the source of this blatant attempt to deceive our citizens with outlandish lies. In the meantime, all personnel are ordered to report any credulous discussion of these rumors.
STRATEGIC UPDATE Orbital Laser Stratagem availability has now ended.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The naked hatred of our enemies has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. Funding issues have unfortunately forced the Records Department to erase the bottom 10% of fallen heroes from their records, affecting all soldiers with last names beginning with Y and Z.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occurred on FORI PRIME, likely merely the result of recent system updates to the TCS+ firmware. While the outbreak is minor and will be contained in due time, Helldivers are welcome to aid in the containment, should they so choose, but the threat is assessed as very low and barely worth attention.
STRATAGEM GRANTED The Orbital Laser Stratagem has been authorized for immediate use on Choepessa IV, for the next 24 hours.

SYSTEMS NOTIFICATION Some Galactic Map users may have observed the apparent presence of enemy forces occupying dozens of planets. This issue was due to an unconcerning software glitch that has since been rectified. This experience may have given rise to some uncomfortable feelings, such as concern, terror, or abject despair. Distressed users are advised to visualize relaxing images, such as: -a fluttering Super Earth flag -a filled-out ballot -the inevitable destruction of Freedom's enemies

NEW MAJOR ORDER Enemy aggression has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. The project has therefore been downscoped to solely consist of the Interrogation Center for Human Rights. To aid development of more effective digital interrogation techniques, the Helldivers are ordered to acquire 35,000,000 Automaton samples and kill 60,000,000 Cyborgs.
SCAVENGER RAMPAGE UPDATE Scavenger numbers on Terminid warfront have returned to normal levels.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Anti-Materiel Rifle Stratagem for forces on the Illuminate front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Orbital Railcannon Strike Stratagem for forces on the Automaton front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the HMG Emplacement Stratagem for forces on the Terminid front has now ended.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The efforts of the Helldivers to support the inspiration and education of our citizens was heartlessly stolen by our enemies. Limited footage of Helldivers defending Freedom was gathered; the decision was made by the studio to instead construct the footage digitally. The ballooning budget means that proceeds can no longer support the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Shield Generator Pack Stratagem for forces on the Illuminate front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Gas Mines Stratagem for forces on the Terminid front has now ended.

STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED Helldivers have contained the outbreak on Nivel 43, securing essential footage for Democratic Sniper. Simultaneously, reports of new Terminid mutations have been investigated; the mutations were determined to be merely superficial changes, well within normal Terminid gene expression. The Ministry of Truth has deemed the filmed footage to be of masterfully evocative cinematic quality. As a result, the remaining major order requirements are reduced by 50%.

NEW STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY A Terminid outbreak has occurred on Nivel 43, likely due to the splintered remnants of the eco-fascistic terrorist network culled in the Counterdissident Hammer campaign. While the threat is assessed as very low, it presents an opportunity to capture vital footage of their wanton aggression. Helldivers must aid in this virtuously expedient cause and liberate Nivel 43. Securing the footage will reduce remaining major order requirement by 50%.
SCAVENGER RAMPAGE Significantly higher Scavenger numbers have been observed on the Terminid warfront.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Shield Generator Relay Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Illuminate warfront, for the next 48 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Gas Mines Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Terminid warfront, for the next 48 hours.

ARSENAL BOOST High Command has authorized high-volume use of the Orbital Railcannon Stratagem on the Automaton warfront. For operations on that warfront, the mandated waiting period between salvos has been lowered by 120 seconds for the next 72 hours.

tacticalActions.name: EAGLE STORM
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Deploys periodic Eagle Gas Strikes during missions. Slows enemy progress in Defense Campaigns.

tacticalActions.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet. The Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.

tacticalActions.name: HEAVY ORDNANCE DISTRIBUTION
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Gives access to the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage stratagem during missions. Accelerates progress in Liberation Campaigns.

active_campaign.title: SERENE GUARDIAN
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: Minor and routine Terminid incursions in vicinity of TCS+ facilities have caused unmerited anxiety in the civilian sector, lowering spending and tempering investments. While the Terminid “threat” is entirely imagined, as the TCS+ is impermeable, the threat of economic slowdown is very real. The Helldivers must reassure our citizens of the Federation’s total control.
active_campaign.description_cn: TCS+设施附近发生的轻微且例行的终结族入侵在平民分区引起了不必要的焦虑，导致民间消费下降，还阻碍了商业投资。虽然终结族的“威胁”完全是想象出来的，因为TCS+坚不可摧，但经济放缓的威胁却是非常真实的。绝地潜兵必须向公民保证，联邦拥有绝对的控制权。

phases.title: ASSURANCE
phases.briefing:
Seditious false rumors regarding TCS+ malfunctions are spreading amongst civilians. SEAF Intelligence confirms any perceived structural failures are in fact scheduled mechanical upkeep, and not Terminid breaches. There is zero actionable peril to fully insured citizens.

However, the resulting entirely unfounded economic panic in the run-up to Liberty Day, affecting all enterprises other than the hygiene paper industry, must be quelled.

To restore public confidence, the Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 700,000,000 Terminids. To aid in swiftly safeguarding Federal prosperity, High Command has authorized and subsidized fleetwide availability of the INCINERATOR FRV Stratagem.
phases.briefing_cn:
关于TCS+发生故障的煽动性虚假谣言正在平民中传播。SEAF情报部门证实，被认为是结构故障的所有事件，实际上都是预定的机械维护，而不是终结族突破。公民只要全额购买保险，就完全不会遇到危险。

然而，就在解放日来临之前，毫无根据的经济恐慌，影响了除卫生纸行业以外的所有企业，我们必须平息这种恐慌。

为了恢复公众信心，绝地潜兵奉命消灭700,000,000只终结族。为了协助我方迅速展开行动，捍卫联邦的繁荣，最高指挥部已授权并拨款资助，为整支舰队提供INCINERATOR FRV战略配备。

phases.title: CONTAINMENT
phases.briefing:
In an unprovoked, unforeseeable assault illustrative of their depravity, a newly mutated strain of Terminids have launched a wave of attacks across multiple TCS+ sectors, threatening to smother innocent colonies in a sea of fascist insect tyranny.

Preliminary studies by experts at the Xenoentomology Center confirm these mutations to be extremely venomous, leading High Command to declare a localized bio-hazard emergency.

The Helldivers must successfully defend against 7 Terminid attacks to halt this tyrannical onslaught and restore order.
phases.briefing_cn:
终结族发动了一次不可预见的无端袭击，一种新型变种在多个TCS+分区发起了一波又一波的攻势，威胁要将无辜的拓殖地淹没在法西斯害虫的暴政之中。

异星昆虫学研究中心专家进行了初步研究，证实这些变异具有极强的毒性，导致最高指挥部宣布进入局部生化危害紧急状态。

绝地潜兵必须成功抵御住7轮终结族攻势，阻止这场暴虐的猛攻，恢复秩序。

为了恢复公众信心，绝地潜兵奉命消灭700,000,000只终结族。为了协助我方迅速展开行动，捍卫联邦的繁荣，最高指挥部已授权并拨款资助，为整支舰队提供INCINERATOR FRV战略配备。
